Can I add two invoices in one e-way bill? No, you cannot generate a single e-way bill against two invoices. However, you can use a consolidated e-way bill to group two or more e-way bills. Should I generate e-way bills against invoices raised for supply services? No, e-way bill rules do not apply to service-oriented transactions. Therefore, you do not need to generate an e-way bill for the supply of services. Is an e-way bill required when goods are transported within a 10 km radius? Goods moved within a state do not require an e-way bill if the distance is within 10 km. The limit has now been increased to 50 km. How many days after raising an invoice should I generate the e-way bill for delayed delivery? The e-way bill is necessary at the time of goods delivery. If the invoice is raised but the goods are not yet delivered, you can generate Part-A of the e-way bill. Part-B details can be added later upon delivery, and the validity of the e-way bill begins when Part-B is entered. How is the criteria of "Value of Consignment of Goods" applied? "Value of Consignment of Goods" is interpreted as follows: If the invoice value exceeds Rs. 50,000 OR If a vehicle carries goods against multiple invoices, and the aggregate invoice value exceeds Rs. 50,000. If either of these conditions is met, you should generate an e-way bill. Invoice value includes the transaction value on the invoicae, including all taxes, except the value of exempt goods carried alongside taxable goods and billed together.

sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Under the Goods and Services Tax (GST), transporters are required to generate an e-way bill when transporting goods between places, with some conditions. Let’s learn about e-way bill generation in India.

The E-Way Bill is an electronic tracking document for the movement of goods created by the E-Way Bill Portal. According to GST rules, a registered person may not move any such goods exceeding fifty thousand rupees (for a single invoice, bill, or delivery challan) in a vehicle without having an e-way bill generated on ewaybillgst.gov.in.

E-way bills can also be generated or cancelled through SMS, Android apps, and site-to-site integration over API by entering the correct GSTIN of all parties involved. Before you commence using the GSTIN, it is essential to verify it by using the GST search tool.
When the E-way Bill is generated, an E-way Bill Number (EBN) is generated and provided to the supplier, recipient, and transporter.
Reduces Tax Evasion:The e-way bill system acts to reduce tax evasion with the right amount of tax collected at the right time from the right party.
Ease of Documentation:The e-way bill system reduces the documentation burden, simplifies, and makes the documentation activities smooth and efficient.
Faster Movement of Goods:The goods movement is much faster with the e-way bill system, which means they spend less time in transit.

For Registered Persons: As a top e-way bill generation company, service plus mentions that, If the goods are being carried to or from a registered person, the value of the goods must exceed Rs 50,000 for an E-Way bill to be issued. In the case of an example of goods valued at less than Rs 50,000, the registered person or transporter can generate and carry an e-way bill.

For Unregistered Persons: Even the unregistered person has to create an e-way bill. In the case where the service provider is unregistered and the service recipient is registered, then the recipient needs to comply with all necessary compliance, as the supplier needs to comply.
For Transporters: In case of goods movement via road, air, rail, etc., the transporters are obliged to generate and provide an e-way bill if the supplier has not already generated the e-way bill.
Step 1: Navigate and open e-way bill system & log in.
Once you are there, fill in your Username, Password and Captcha code and click on 'Login.'
Step 2: The left side of the dashboard will have the 'E-waybill' option; click on 'Generate new.'
Step 3: Complete the necessary fields on the screen that appears:
Transaction Field: If you are the supplier of the consignment, select outward; if you are the recipient, select inward.

Can I add two invoices in one e-way bill?
No, you cannot generate a single e-way bill against two invoices. However, you can use a consolidated e-way bill to group two or more e-way bills.
Should I generate e-way bills against invoices raised for supply services?
No, e-way bill rules do not apply to service-oriented transactions. Therefore, you do not need to generate an e-way bill for the supply of services.
Is an e-way bill required when goods are transported within a 10 km radius?
Goods moved within a state do not require an e-way bill if the distance is within 10 km. The limit has now been increased to 50 km.
How many days after raising an invoice should I generate the e-way bill for delayed delivery?

The e-way bill is necessary at the time of goods delivery. If the invoice is raised but the goods are not yet delivered, you can generate Part-A of the e-way bill. Part-B details can be added later upon delivery, and the validity of the e-way bill begins when Part-B is entered.

"Value of Consignment of Goods" is interpreted as follows: If the invoice value exceeds Rs. 50,000 OR If a vehicle carries goods against multiple invoices, and the aggregate invoice value exceeds Rs. 50,000. If either of these conditions is met, you should generate an e-way bill. Invoice value includes the transaction value on the invoicae, including all taxes, except the value of exempt goods carried alongside taxable goods and billed together.
